title: Company overview
text: Nimbus Logistics is a fictional freight and parcel company founded in 2014 in Rotterdam. It operates 42 warehouses across Europe and runs a fleet of 1,300 electric delivery vans. The company's mission is to make same-day delivery carbon neutral by 2030. Headquarters staff work on a hybrid schedule, three days in the office and two days remote.

title: Parental leave policy
text: Employees who become parents, whether by birth, adoption, or foster placement, are entitled to 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Leave can be taken in up to three blocks within the first 18 months. Employees should notify their manager and People Operations at least 8 weeks before the planned start date.

title: Expense reimbursement
text: Business expenses must be submitted through the Ledgerly portal within 30 days of purchase. Receipts are required for any item over 25 EUR. Meals while travelling are capped at 60 EUR per day. Reimbursements are paid with the next monthly payroll run. Alcohol is never reimbursable.

title: Travel booking rules
text: All business travel must be booked through the TripDesk tool. Economy class is the default for flights under 6 hours; premium economy is allowed for longer flights. Trains are preferred over flights for journeys under 4 hours. Hotel bookings must stay below the city rate cap listed in TripDesk.

title: Error code E-4012
text: Error E-4012 appears on handheld scanners when a parcel barcode cannot be matched to a manifest. The most common cause is a manifest that has not yet synced from the depot server. Fix: pull down to refresh the manifest on the scanner, wait 30 seconds, and scan again. If the error persists, escalate to the depot supervisor.

title: Error code E-7730
text: Error E-7730 means the scanner battery temperature is outside the safe range. The device will refuse to charge until it cools down or warms up to between 5 and 40 degrees Celsius. Do not leave scanners in van cabs overnight during winter or summer.

title: Van charging procedure
text: Electric vans must be plugged in at the depot at the end of every shift. Drivers should use the bay assigned on the shift sheet. Charging to 80 percent is the default to protect battery health; select the 100 percent option only when the next route exceeds 180 km. Report any damaged charging cable immediately.

title: Accident reporting
text: If a driver is involved in a road accident, they must first make sure everyone is safe and call emergency services if anyone is injured. Then photograph the scene, exchange details with the other party, and file an incident report in the FleetCare app within 24 hours. Never admit liability at the scene.

title: Damaged parcel handling
text: Parcels that arrive at a depot visibly damaged must be photographed and tagged with a red DMG label. The parcel is then moved to the inspection cage. Customer service contacts the sender within one business day to offer repacking, return, or a claim.

title: Customer refund policy
text: Customers can claim a full refund of the shipping fee when a Priority parcel is delivered more than 24 hours late. Lost parcels are reimbursed up to the declared value, with a maximum of 500 EUR for standard accounts and 2,500 EUR for business accounts. Claims must be filed within 60 days.

title: Service tiers
text: Nimbus offers three service tiers. Standard delivers in 2 to 4 business days. Priority delivers the next business day before 18:00. Same-Day delivers within 6 hours in 12 metropolitan areas, including Amsterdam, Berlin, Paris, and Milan. Same-Day orders must be placed before 12:00 local time.

title: Package size limits
text: The maximum parcel weight is 31.5 kg. The longest side may not exceed 175 cm, and length plus girth may not exceed 300 cm. Oversized items must be booked as freight through the Nimbus Freight desk, which uses pallets and a separate pricing table.

title: Prohibited items
text: Nimbus does not carry lithium batteries shipped on their own, compressed gases, flammable liquids, live animals, cash, or firearms. Batteries installed inside a device such as a laptop or phone are allowed if the device is switched off and protected against accidental activation.

title: Route optimisation system
text: Daily delivery routes are generated by an internal system called Pathfinder. Pathfinder runs at 04:30 every morning and uses a vehicle routing solver that considers traffic forecasts, van range, and delivery time windows. Dispatchers may manually move up to 10 percent of stops before routes are locked at 06:00.

title: Warehouse safety
text: High-visibility vests and safety shoes are mandatory on every warehouse floor. Forklifts may only be driven by staff holding a valid certificate, which must be renewed every three years. Pedestrian walkways are marked in green and must be kept clear at all times.

title: IT password policy
text: Passwords for Nimbus systems must be at least 14 characters long. Multi-factor authentication through the Authenticator app is required for email, Ledgerly, and FleetCare. Passwords never expire unless a compromise is suspected. Never share credentials, even with IT staff.

title: Laptop and equipment
text: New office employees receive a laptop, a headset, and a monitor on their first day. Hardware is refreshed every four years. Lost or stolen equipment must be reported to the IT Service Desk within 2 hours so the device can be remotely locked and wiped.

title: Onboarding programme
text: New hires follow a four-week onboarding programme. Week one covers company history, tools, and safety training. In week two they shadow a colleague in their team. Each new hire is assigned an onboarding buddy who is not their manager. The programme ends with a 30-day check-in with People Operations.

title: Performance reviews
text: Performance reviews take place twice a year, in March and September. Each review combines a self-assessment, manager feedback, and input from two peers chosen by the employee. Salary adjustments are decided once a year after the March review cycle.

title: Annual leave
text: Full-time employees receive 27 days of paid annual leave per year, plus public holidays of their country. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over to the following year and must be used before 31 March. Leave requests go through the HR portal and need manager approval.

title: Sick leave
text: Employees who are ill should notify their manager before the start of their shift or workday. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days. Drivers must not drive while taking medication that warns against operating vehicles.

title: Sustainability programme
text: The GreenMile programme tracks the carbon footprint of every delivery. All depots switched to renewable electricity in 2022. Customers can choose a consolidated weekly delivery option, which bundles parcels to cut emissions. Progress is published in an annual sustainability report every April.

title: Customer API
text: Business customers can create shipments through the Nimbus REST API. Requests are authenticated with an API key sent in the X-Nimbus-Key header. The rate limit is 600 requests per minute per key. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429; clients should retry with exponential backoff. Webhooks notify customers of status changes.

title: Tracking statuses
text: A shipment moves through these statuses: CREATED, PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT, AT_DEPOT, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED. If delivery fails, the status becomes ATTEMPTED and the parcel is retried the next business day. After three failed attempts the parcel is returned to the sender.

title: Failed delivery options
text: When nobody is home, drivers may leave the parcel with a neighbour, at a safe place chosen by the recipient, or at a Nimbus pickup point. Parcels that need a signature are never left at a safe place. Pickup points hold parcels for 7 days before returning them.

title: Peak season operations
text: Peak season runs from mid-November to the end of December. During peak, temporary staff are hired through partner agencies, Sunday deliveries are added in major cities, and annual leave for operations staff is restricted between 20 November and 24 December.

title: Code of conduct
text: Nimbus expects every employee to treat colleagues and customers with respect. Harassment, discrimination, and bribery are not tolerated. Gifts from suppliers worth more than 50 EUR must be declared. Concerns can be raised anonymously through the SpeakUp hotline.
